# Vendored dependencies

Third-party dependencies bundled so this package runs offline without `npm install`.
Their original licenses still apply (MIT / Apache-2.0).

| Package | Source | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `@braccato/parsers` | Better Lyrics (@braccato) | TTML / LRC / QRC / SRT / plain parsers |
| `fast-xml-parser` | NaturalIntelligence | XML parser (used by the TTML parser) |
| `xml-naming` | fast-xml-parser dependency | XML element name validation |
| `path-expression-matcher` | fast-xml-parser dependency | nested node access |
| `@nodable/entities` | fast-xml-parser dependency | HTML/XML entity decoding |
| `is-unsafe` | fast-xml-parser dependency | prototype pollution protection |
| `strnum` / `anynum` | fast-xml-parser dependencies | number parsing
